source_line: PAI Design Workbench · Demo A, robot work cell · recorded live on pai.oneai.host · UI in Chinese

segments.headline: Robot work cell: cycle time from {loop.mujocoRejection.referenceCycleSeconds} s down to 5 s or less
segments.detail: No collisions, at least 90 % of 10 seeds succeed, motor bracket stays stiff under the belt load

segments.step: 2  MuJoCo runs the engineer's first draft on 10 seeds
segments.headline: Joint speed 75 %, guard pulled in to {loop.mujocoRejection.cell.guardClearance} m: cycle {loop.mujocoRejection.cycleSeconds} s
segments.detail: Fast enough, but {loop.mujocoRejection.collisionFreeSeeds} of {loop.mujocoRejection.of} seeds are collision-free: the elbow hits the guard. Rejected

segments.step: 3  Ask AI on the failed check
segments.headline: {loop.aiCellFix.engine.model} via Kiro {loop.aiCellFix.engine.engineVersion}: guard clearance 0.12 → 0.3 m
segments.detail: Speed kept at 75 %, no requirement relaxed. The AI only proposes; the change is re-simulated

segments.headline: Cycle {loop.fixedCell.cycleSeconds} s: {lighter:loop.fixedCell.cycleSeconds|loop.mujocoRejection.referenceCycleSeconds} % faster than the reference, 10 of 10 seeds succeed
segments.detail: The failure case is closed by a bound retest, not overwritten

segments.headline: Release {loop.release.number}: admission {loop.release.admission}, every failure case closed
segments.detail: Evidence and all native files (STEP, FEA, MJCF) signed with AWS KMS, ECDSA P-256
